lines.en: Grass blades brush along my stripes.
The river's close — I can smell it.
When grass yellows, my hide stands out.
We walk in single file.

lines.zh: 条纹一挤一挤，我们一起走。
lines.en: Stripes pressed together, we walk as a herd.

lines.zh: 草原的草到我肚子，正好藏身。
lines.en: Savanna grass reaches my belly, good cover.
So hot I keep flapping my ears.
One gust and my mane flies wild.

lines.zh: 草根在热带草原的土里挪动。
lines.en: Grass roots shift in the savanna soil.
Hooves crunch through the dry grass.

lines.zh: 草原的条纹，跑起来最乱。
lines.en: The stripes blur when I run.
Head down, I graze as I walk.
Who sneezed? Me.
I chewed a while; no taste at all.
A herdmate watches my back.
Black and white stripes, all in a line.
The sun makes my stripes burn.
Another savanna leaf falls.
The foal walks among us, safe.
I stand dead still, playing rock.
I doze standing, legs locked straight.
Dried mud on my back itches.
These flies are a plague — swish, tail.
Hot wind turns the grass to waves.

lines.zh: 我们的条纹，挤在一起就分不清。
lines.en: Our stripes blur when we crowd.
The cloud passed, I never moved.
Hooves far off — not ours.

lines.zh: 草原的草，比蘑菇高多了。
lines.en: Savanna grass grows far higher than mushrooms.
No trees on the savanna — just sun.
My stripes bake in the savanna sun.
Too close — back up a bit.
That hat of yours — I've seen it.
Is that a stick in your hand?

lines.zh: 条纹一晃，你就分不清头尾。
lines.en: One flash of stripes and you lose my head from my tail.
Your scent is unfamiliar.

lines.zh: 黑白条纹，草原上最显眼。
lines.en: Black and white, plainest on the savanna.
We watch you; you watch us.
How long have you crouched in that grass?
We line up in stripes across the savanna.

lines.zh: 草原上，我们三四只一起走。
lines.en: On the savanna, three or four of us walk together.
Those colors stand out too much.
Don't count my stripes — you'll lose.
A bite taken out of my hide.
The hide is cut — never mind.

lines.zh: 我们三只一起走，尘土很高。
lines.en: Three of us walk together, raising dust.

lines.zh: 我还站着，别得意，条纹还亮。
lines.en: I am still standing; my stripes still shine.
It hurts so I kick out.
My hide got scraped open.
Blood seeps between my stripes.
My roots are still planted firm.

lines.zh: 草原的草，够我们四只吃。
lines.en: This savanna grass feeds all four of us.
I flick my tail to chase a fly.

lines.zh: 水，我听见远处的水声了。
lines.en: Water; I hear water far off.
Grain in your hand, isn't it?
That grass looks sweet.
I'll step closer — just to sniff.
The smell rides the wind over here.
Set it down and I’ll edge closer.
Just a small bite — okay?
My hooves have crept forward.

lines.zh: 水声，热带草原的河不远了。
lines.en: Water sounds; the savanna river is near.
Did you spill salt on the ground?
You have knocked my stripes out of line.
Squeeze over — let us all through.
You knocked my stripes crooked.
Bone against bone — hard.
You've squeezed into the herd.
My hind legs buckle under me.
The savanna's wide — let's both give way.
That knocked my stripes crooked.
Before you bump, note how heavy I am.
My hide is worth exactly one leather.
Nose to nose — done.
Don't mistake me for a horse.
We move on once the foal can run.
I circle round while you watch.

lines.zh: 成群的斑马，风里也认得出。
lines.en: Even in wind, the herd knows each other.
You only see my stripes when I run.

lines.zh: 草原上，我的条纹晃成一片。
lines.en: On the savanna, my stripes blur together.
The savanna is wide enough to run.
We walk one trail and graze the whole way.

lines.zh: 斑纹一对，草原上就认得。
lines.en: Match the stripes and the savanna knows you.
Dry grass rustles when chewed.
Whose hat? I'm carrying it.
One kick of mine flattens the grass.

lines.zh: 条纹底下藏的东西，别看。
lines.en: What's under my stripes stays hidden.
Carrying it in my mouth slows me.

lines.zh: 这块骨头，我先收进草里。
lines.en: I'll tuck this bone into the grass.
I'll bring it back for the foal to chew.

lines.zh: 条纹在草原上，晃得眼花。
lines.en: Stripes blur together on the savanna.

lines.zh: 埋下去，明年就是一棵树。
lines.en: Bury it, and next year it is a tree.
This grass is prickly, but I take it.
Water ahead — I know the way.
Locked on — running won't help.
We close in and block both ends.
Your scent won't sit still.
Your shadow gave you away.
Stripes on the savanna blur the eye.
Hold still — I'm coming over.
This patch will feed the herd.
That clump of grass — mine.
I see you, hiding in the grass.
Stop, and I'm on you.
Saving my strength for the final run.
Black and white stripes, moving as a herd.
The grass is too short to hide you.
I trot along — not tired.
Hooves getting closer — hear them?

lines.zh: 我的条纹一抖，你的影子就乱。
lines.en: One flick of my stripes and your shadow scatters.

lines.zh: 条纹一晃，你数不清有几匹。
lines.en: One flash of stripes and you lose count.
Around, then flank from the side.
Row after row of hoofprints, all noted.
I bite, though my teeth are for grass.
My forehooves come down heavy.
This kick will lay you out.

lines.zh: 我们三四只一起跑，尘土很大。
lines.en: Three or four of us run, raising plenty of dust.
Run — don't stand in my lane.
Clear out — I'm charging.
The whole herd backs me up.

lines.zh: 我后腿一蹬，砂土飞起来。
lines.en: One kick of my hind legs and the grit flies.
A kick of my hind legs throws sand.
One charge, and your ribs creak.
Can I eat this grass?
I stood up the moment I was born.

lines.zh: 草原上的风吹得我鬃毛乱。
lines.en: The savanna wind tangles my mane.

lines.zh: 我们一群三四匹，蹄声很齐。
lines.en: We run three or four together, hooves in step.
Three or four of us walk together.
My legs are weak — don't push me.
Hooves on soil — that feels right.
Wind so strong I can't open my eyes.
The foal stands, legs still shaking.
Savanna — here I am.
Mother's over there — I'm going to her.
I'm the smallest of the herd.
Smoke still rises from my stripes.
My hooves slipped — I took a spill.
River up to my back — I kick.
A blast, and dust covers me.

lines.zh: 草原上中了一箭，真不讲理。
lines.en: An arrow on the savanna — how rude.
A spell scrambled my stripes.
The grass withered; my belly is flat.

lines.zh: 雷落在草原上，我的条纹都黑了。
lines.en: Lightning on the savanna blackened my stripes.
Nothing beneath my hooves — no grass.
